reviews.x: I get my nails professionally done.. but sometimes I hate paying the extra money for bling.. So I decided to do it myself. Bought this to use since it’s a no wipe. I flash cured in between crystals (10-15 seconds so it didn’t move).. Oh my god this stuff is amazing! I use a little UV lamp I bought off of Amazon as well. (Along with the crystals).

This is a thicker gel coat. I wasn't sure how it would wear, but so far it is the only top coat that has not lifted and chipped or pealed off after 1 week. I still use alcohol to clean even though you don't need too. I used this on top of nail stamp and it didn't smear the stamp either.

This topcoat is the best topcoat I’ve ever had! It goes on so easy and a little bit goes a long way. It also does really well with Chrome it makes jewels hold in place really well with the glue and it makes everything stay ultra shiny for a long long time. I have been using this topcoat for over a year now and my clients get upset if I run out of it.
This is by far the best gel topcoat I’ve tried!  I used to be loyal to Gelish and OPI gel polish, both of which peel.  This one stays put, and looks brand new for weeks!  Highly recommend!
Not as good as the one I bought that needs cleanser. Won’t buy again.

Liked this at first, but after a few days wear it began chipping and coming off the end of my nail tips. Not as durable as the original wipe top coat or other brands of no wipe gel top coats. I won’t be buying again. I’m bummed cause I love all DND gels so far!
The DND gel collection seems to last longer and is the shiniest/glossiest clear gel coat I’ve used. It doesn’t shrink like some clear coats I’ve used. It also works well with other brands as well.
When I recorded this order. The product top was not on tight so it had been leaking. I will keep it bc i need it right then but im very disappointed in the deliverance of the item.
I’ve been getting my nails done my entire life using this top coat however when I used this top coat it made my fingers swell so much I had to go to the ER

This produce at the salon places work great. My nails will stay shiny for almost 3 weeks. For some reason this is not staying for even s week. I'm very disappointed since I can trust to amazon to buy another DND product.

reviews.t: ... gel manicures if the shine is getting a little dull. It doesn't peel off at all
reviews.x: I use this with my UV light in between gel manicures if the shine is getting a little dull. It doesn't peel off at all.
I swear by this product!!! It last and its shineyyyyyyyy !!!!! I gotta reup on a bunch soon ! And the price is bomb😰

reviews.t: Just Ok. Not what I expected!
reviews.x: This clear coat just comes off and peels off very easily. It is thick which I thought would be good however it just peels off just as much or worse than the thin. The parts that don't peel off get stuck on and wont come off so I have half nails that have a top coat and half of the same nail that has nothing. Very disappointing! It is very shiny and looks nice when first applied! Doesn't last a week though!

reviews.t: Keeps manicure lasting for a solid 2 weeks!
reviews.x: The only top coat that helps my gel mani lasting a solid two weeks.  I use this in combination with Red Carpet Manicure cleanser, prep and base coat.  Then, DND gel colors and THIS top coat.  I’ve tried many brands, ranging from pricey to affordable.  This top coat is my magic tool to keeping a lasting mani.

This top coat will forever by in my top 5 of top coats to use. The consistency is not too thick and not too runny. It does have a slight yellowish tone to it after I have had it for about 5 months but it still works just fine. It doesn't alter the color of my gel polishes so I will be ordering more.

Let me tell this top coat is amazing,I wasn't sure if I should buy it after reading the reviews on it, not sure why a lot of these buyers had any issues with this gel product.this is one of my favorite top coat and the best part is no cleanser needed!

reviews.t: Great price, and great Gel Top coat
reviews.x: Cures in LED in 30sec. , great top, very clear and shiny, no cracking and when you lightly buff it with a 1000+ grit buffer it makes a beautiful matte. And ones it's cured there is absolutely no sticky layer, totally cured and perfect

I bought this one because it’s the one the salon uses when I go but they must not be the same because this one is streaky. And you CANNOT RETURN IT. Either buy it through another seller or don’t go with this one at all is my advice
This is a great brand. The product sent out by this vendor is trash. It’s old and expired. The gel is partially cured from the inside of the bottles. Choose a different vendor!!
This is a secret holy grail gel top coat for Me. Makes a manicure done with any brand polish last weeks with a very, long lasting and durable finish with no reapplication.
Had to return, stayed goopy, wouldn't dry.

This is the worst top coat I have ever used. My manicures usually last 2-3 weeks but with this top coat, I'm lucky if it lasts 1 week or a little longer. Very disappointed in this product.  It chips and peels. I did my nails twice and my daughter's once and both our manicures chipped and peeled within a week.

So I bought so many top coats on Amazon I’ve tried beetles, Modelones, aimeli, rose , vshine, Sally’s, airbrit, gotti & supwee  they all looked dull after a day so someone suggested this one & now it’s my go to! It’s thick, goes on smooth & nails look good! Thank god I found a top coat finally!

I love the selection of DND colored gel polish, but their no wipe top coat is an absolute must. The formula isn’t too thick or too thin, you need one coat to finish your gel manicure. Definitely recommend to anyone who does gel manicures at home.

This is the brand I use at the salon! I love to put this over colorstreet! It’s hard to remove so you’ll need pure acetone and nail dremel. DND has excellent gel colors too if you’re able to paint your nails!! Great polish!

claims.text: Many reviewers praise this top coat for lasting long and staying shiny for weeks without peeling or chipping.
Several reviewers report the opposite, saying it chips, peels, or comes off easily and is less durable than other top coats.
Reviewers frequently mention it works well with other products, including chrome, nail stamps, crystals, and other brands.
A few reviewers describe the consistency as thick, which some find helpful and others find causes peeling.
A small number of reviewers report problems unrelated to performance, such as a leaking bottle or finger swelling.
